_doc: Machine-readable scope for the core and the optional plugin tier. Read by plugins/scopecheck.py (CI) and by plugins/api.py at run time. Changed only by a reviewed PR; trust never widens it by itself.
core_mission: Bootstrap a working, server-side, self-managing system from a person's stated wish: the tick, virtual managers and staff, trust ladder, predictions, plussing, interrupt gate, and the specifications and management artifacts they run on.

core.rule: Nothing on the core path imports, requires, spawns or names a plugin. A plugin may be removed and the core must still boot and pass its tests.

plugin_tier.rule: optional, never in the core path
live_requires: trust rung at or above the action class minimum
plugin_tier.credentials: Adapter config holds environment-binding NAMES only. Values live in the platform secret store and are read at run time. Nothing in this repo holds a secret.

draft.reach: writes a file in this repo only

describe_self.reach: reads this repo, writes self-description files

cloud_read.reach: read-only calls to an allowlisted cloud API

send_to_person.reach: one email to one consented, unsuppressed recipient

publish_public.reach: one public post to a configured channel, text from the guard-approved self-description only

publish_video.reach: upload one video as private or unlisted; public release is a gate card

cloud_write.reach: create or update a resource the plugin created, tagged as managed

out_of_bounds: moving or committing money: payments, ad spend, purchases, billing changes
signing, filing or accepting terms for the owner
sending from or posting to the owner's personal accounts
bulk or unsolicited mail, scraped address lists, any recipient without recorded consent
collecting, storing, printing or committing credentials
deleting cloud resources or data a plugin did not create
publishing figures, customers, results or claims not present in the self-description
any plugin imported by the core path

roles.outreach: who we contact, with consent, and what happened
roles.marketing: what we say in public and where
roles.branding: how the system sees and describes itself
roles.communications: what the owner wants to communicate, and the reports that go out
roles.operations: cloud resources the system manages for itself, read-first
